Hero.title: Electronics that <accent>never fail.</accent>
Hero.description: Advanced electronics manufacturing, from development to the finished product. Our technological solutions serve a wide range of applications in the railway industry, healthcare, industrial automation and energy. A family business with manufacturing in Czechia and Poland. From PCB assembly to complete box build, serving customers in more than 30 countries.

AboutHero.title: Your partner for electronics manufacturing and development
AboutHero.description: Since 1997, Hokami CZ s.r.o. has been one of the leading Czech providers of electronics manufacturing services (EMS). We offer comprehensive solutions from material sourcing and printed circuit board production through SMT and THT assembly and testing to final assembly, programming, conformal coating, potting and complete logistics. Over 60% of our electricity comes from our own solar power plant.

AboutCampus.title: Campus
AboutCampus.description: Hokami Campus is also home to other companies and services that together create a modern environment for work and everyday life. The campus includes technology company Cleartex, dental clinic Dolident, café Dolicafe and coffee roastery DoodleBeans.

AboutHistory.title: From 1997 to the present
AboutHistory.description: Through long-term investment in the latest manufacturing technologies, automation and quality control, we can take full manufacturing responsibility for our customers’ electronic products. Using the technical documentation provided, we deliver finished products ready for immediate use or integration into final equipment.
AboutHistory.invitation: Explore the major milestones, technological advances and key moments that have shaped our company.
AboutHistory.conclusion: Electronics manufactured by Hokami are used in a wide range of demanding sectors, including industry, medical technology, energy, rail transport, consumer electronics, the automotive industry, aviation and space technology. Our solutions are part of equipment that customers around the world rely on every day.

SustainabilityHero.title: Sustainability
SustainabilityHero.description: At Hokami, we see sustainability as a natural part of modern electronics manufacturing and the long-term development of our company. Environmental responsibility, efficient use of resources and continuous improvement of manufacturing processes are firmly embedded in our day-to-day operations and strategic decisions. Our goal is to manufacture electronics with the utmost emphasis on quality, efficiency and minimising environmental impact.

SustainabilityEnergy.title: Energy efficiency and modern technology
SustainabilityEnergy.technology: We continuously invest in modern manufacturing technologies that help reduce energy consumption, optimise production processes and use materials more efficiently. Our investments also include regular upgrades to manufacturing equipment, the use of energy-efficient machinery, intelligent energy management and extensive use of LED lighting across our facilities.
SustainabilityEnergy.photovoltaics: Our own photovoltaic power plant supplies a significant share of the electricity consumed by the company, currently covering more than 60% of total consumption. By combining our own energy generation with modern technologies, we reduce the energy intensity of production over the long term and support the company's sustainable development.

SustainabilityProduction.title: Responsible manufacturing
SustainabilityProduction.processes: Our manufacturing processes are designed to meet the highest standards of quality, safety and environmental protection. We focus on efficient use of materials, minimising production losses and responsible handling of the waste we generate.
SustainabilityProduction.materials: We use lead-free manufacturing processes and comply with the requirements of the RoHS Directive and the REACH Regulation. We handle chemicals safely and in accordance with applicable legislation. All waste is sorted and handed over to authorised partners for recycling or environmentally sound disposal.

supplyChain.title: A responsible supply chain
supplyChain.description: Sustainability extends beyond the factory. We work with trusted suppliers who share our requirements for quality, transparency and responsible business practices. When planning production and logistics, we strive to use transport capacity efficiently, optimise the supply chain and reduce unnecessary transport operations.

people.title: People and company culture
people.description: Employees are a key part of our approach. We promote an environment in which responsible behaviour is a natural part of everyday work. We regularly train employees in occupational safety, environmental protection and the proper handling of materials and waste. We also encourage employee initiatives that improve manufacturing processes, increase efficiency and reduce environmental impact.

improvement.title: Continuous improvement
improvement.description: We see sustainability as a long-term process rather than a one-off project. We therefore continually assess our manufacturing processes, invest in innovation and seek new opportunities to reduce energy intensity, use resources more efficiently and further develop responsible manufacturing.

SustainabilityContact.title: Looking for an electronics manufacturing partner?
SustainabilityContact.description: Our goal is to be a reliable partner for customers around the world and a company that contributes to the responsible development of the electronics industry. We believe that high manufacturing quality, technological innovation and environmental responsibility form the foundation of a sustainable business over the long term.

contact.title: Looking for an electronics manufacturing partner?

hero.title: SMT
hero.description: SMT (Surface Mount Technology) forms the foundation of modern electronics manufacturing and is one of Hokami’s key technologies. Drawing on many years of experience, advanced equipment and carefully controlled manufacturing processes, we produce electronic assemblies from prototypes to high-volume production. Our aim is to provide customers with reliable, flexible and high-quality manufacturing solutions that meet the requirements of a wide range of industries.

production.title: Four automated SMT lines
production.description: Production runs on four fully automated SMT lines using modern Yamaha and Assembleon placement technologies. The manufacturing process is controlled with an emphasis on maximum precision, repeatability and the quality of every assembled joint. We routinely work with manufacturing documentation supplied by the customer and, when needed, provide technical support to optimise product designs for series production (DFM).
production.imageAlt: An operator working at a machine on a HOKAMI SMT production line.

reflow.title: Reflow soldering
reflow.description: After the SMD components have been placed, reflow soldering creates high-quality solder joints with lasting reliability. Our reflow ovens allow precise control of temperature profiles for both lead-free and leaded soldering, ensuring high manufacturing quality even for technologically demanding electronic assemblies. Our modern soldering technologies enable us to process a wide range of products, from standard industrial applications to electronics with stringent quality and reliability requirements.
reflow.imageAlt: A close-up of a printed circuit board and component feeders in a placement machine.

dimensions.title: Board dimensions
dimensions.description: Our equipment can assemble printed circuit boards measuring up to 810 × 480 mm. Regular investment in manufacturing technology and automation enables us to respond flexibly to individual customer requirements and deliver technically demanding projects.

capacity.title: Production capacity
capacity.description: Our current production capacity exceeds 40 million SMT placements per month, allowing us to handle prototypes, medium-sized series and high-volume orders efficiently while maintaining high quality and short lead times.

express.title: Express production
express.description: For time-critical projects, we also offer an express manufacturing service, with production able to start within 24 hours of receiving the complete manufacturing documentation.

bonding.title: Wire bonding
bonding.description: Our technological capabilities also include gold-wire bonding, aluminium-wire bonding and Glob Top technology, enabling specialised applications that require advanced methods of interconnecting semiconductor components.

contact.title: Looking for an electronics manufacturing partner?
contact.description: By combining modern SMT technologies, precisely controlled reflow soldering, an experienced team and rigorous quality control, we offer customers comprehensive electronics manufacturing solutions focused on maximum reliability, flexibility and the long-term quality of finished products.

hero.title: Careers
hero.description: At Hokami, you will find the stability of a Czech company with almost thirty years of experience, opportunities for professional growth and work with modern technologies. Attractive employee benefits, a friendly team and long-term prospects come as standard.

hero.title: Printed circuit boards
hero.description: A high-quality printed circuit board is the foundation of every reliable electronic product. Hokami arranges PCB manufacturing through a proven network of long-standing partners with whom we have worked for many years. This allows us to offer a broad range of technologies, high manufacturing quality and short lead times for both prototype and series production.

first.title: A comprehensive service
first.p1: We supply single-sided, double-sided and multilayer printed circuit boards manufactured precisely to customer requirements. Technical support in selecting suitable materials, surface finishes and manufacturing technologies is an integral part of our service, taking into account the required electrical, mechanical and environmental properties of the finished product.
first.p2: Through close integration with our SMT and THT production processes, we provide a complete service from PCB manufacturing through assembly, testing and final product assembly to dispatch. Customers gain a single reliable partner for the entire manufacturing process.
first.imageAlt: Printed circuit boards with fine copper tracks.

second.title: Quality without compromise
second.p1: Every PCB we supply meets strict quality and reliability requirements. Manufacturing follows internationally recognised standards, and each production batch undergoes optical and electrical inspection. Our long-standing, proven manufacturing partners enable us to ensure consistent quality, highly repeatable production and flexible delivery schedules.
second.imageAlt: Close-up of printed circuit boards ready for component assembly.

hero.title: THT
hero.description: THT soldering is an integral part of electronics assembly, particularly where high mechanical joint strength, reliability and a long product service life are required. At Hokami, we use modern soldering technologies that enable efficient manufacturing from individual prototypes to high-volume production.

first.title: Choosing the soldering technology
first.p1: We select the most suitable soldering technology according to the product and customer requirements. We use wave soldering for standard series production, while selective soldering is ideal for complex electronic assemblies or combined SMT/THT boards. We also provide manual soldering for prototypes, repairs, adding specific components and products requiring an individual approach.
first.imageAlt: Selective soldering equipment for printed circuit boards.

second.title: Selective soldering
second.p1: Selective soldering applies solder precisely where it is needed, minimising thermal stress on nearby components and ensuring high-quality solder joints even on technically demanding electronic assemblies. Modern automated technologies provide highly repeatable manufacturing processes and consistent quality across all production batches.
second.p2: All soldering takes place under controlled manufacturing conditions and is continuously inspected with an emphasis on quality, reliability and meeting each customer’s individual requirements.
second.imageAlt: An operator manually soldering an electronic assembly.

contact.description: By combining automated and manual soldering technologies, we offer an optimal solution for a wide range of electronic applications, ensuring high-quality solder joints regardless of product complexity or production volume.

hero.title: Cleaning
hero.description: PCB cleanliness is an important factor in the quality of the finished product. Cleanliness throughout the manufacturing process is managed in accordance with IPC-CH-65B.

first.title: Managed to IPC-CH-65B
first.p1: PCB cleanliness is one of the key factors affecting the reliability, service life and long-term functionality of electronic assemblies. At Hokami, we pay close attention to cleaning and manage the process in accordance with IPC-CH-65B and our customers’ individual specifications.
first.p2: In standard production we use modern no-clean solder pastes and fluxes that meet demanding requirements for solder joint quality and reliability. Where a project requires a higher level of surface cleanliness, we provide professional washing of assembled PCBs using automated cleaning technologies.
first.imageAlt: Assembled printed circuit boards inside a cleaning system.

second.title: Ultrasonic cleaning and high-pressure spray
second.p1: We combine ultrasonic cleaning and high-pressure spray to remove flux residues, ionic contamination and other contaminants. Precisely controlled processes deliver high levels of cleanliness even for technologically demanding electronic assemblies intended for industrial, medical or energy applications.
second.p2: Each cleaning process is tailored to the customer’s requirements and the product’s characteristics, ensuring maximum reliability of the finished product while maintaining high manufacturing efficiency.
second.imageAlt: An automated industrial cleaning system for electronic assemblies.

contact.description: Modern cleaning technologies and carefully controlled processes enable us to deliver the required level of surface cleanliness in accordance with customer specifications and the needs of each application.

hero.title: Testing and quality
hero.description: At Hokami, quality is an integral part of every manufacturing process. Inspection takes place at every stage, from incoming materials through solder paste application and SMT and THT assembly to final assembly, functional testing and dispatch. Our multilayer quality control system ensures high reliability, repeatable production and the highest quality for every electronic assembly.

first.title: Inspection throughout manufacturing
first.p1: Manufacturing processes are managed in accordance with IPC-A-610, while PCB cleanliness follows IPC-CH-65B recommendations. All inspection and testing processes are tailored to the customer’s specific requirements and the characteristics of the product.
first.p2: Quality is verified from the first manufacturing operations. We check solder paste application, component placement accuracy, solder joint quality, electrical properties and the functionality of the finished product. Every step is designed to detect deviations as early as possible and prevent them from affecting the final product’s quality.
first.imageAlt: Optical inspection of a printed circuit board on SAKI equipment.

checks.title: Our quality system includes
checks.spi: SPI (Solder Paste Inspection) – checking solder paste application quality.
checks.aoi: AOI (Automated Optical Inspection) – automated inspection of component placement and solder joints.
checks.bga: BGA inspection using an endoscopic camera.
checks.ict: In-Circuit Test (ICT) – electrical testing of assembled components and connections.
checks.burnIn: Burn-in testing to verify long-term reliability.
checks.highVoltage: High-voltage testing (HV Test) for AC and DC applications.
checks.mechanical: Mechanical testing of buttons, switches, toggle switches and reed relays.
checks.optical: Optical measurement of LEDs and displays, including light intensity and wavelength.
checks.visual: Visual inspection of component dimensions, height and position.

aoi.title: Automated optical inspection (AOI)
aoi.description: Automated optical inspection provides fast, precise checks of PCB assembly quality. AOI systems verify component presence, orientation and position as well as solder joint quality, significantly improving manufacturing reliability.
aoi.endoscope: Endoscopic camera for BGA package inspection

ict.title: In-Circuit Test (ICT)
ict.description: Electrical testing checks individual components, connections and electrical parameters before functional testing begins.

functional.title: Functional testing
functional.description: Functional tests simulate real operating conditions and verify that the product works correctly. We prepare individual test scenarios according to customer requirements and the specific application.
functional.assemblies: Comprehensive functional testing of electronic assemblies
functional.optical: Optical testing of LEDs and displays

traceability.title: Production traceability
traceability.description: Every electronic assembly can be traced throughout manufacturing. Our traceability system records materials, production batches, process operations, test results and individual manufacturing parameters. This ensures maximum manufacturing transparency and meets the requirements of customers in industries with demanding quality standards.

esd.title: ESD protection
esd.description: All manufacturing and testing takes place in an ESD-protected environment. Strict electrostatic protection rules minimise the risk of damage to sensitive electronic components during manufacturing, handling and testing.

calibration.title: Calibration of measuring equipment
calibration.description: All measuring and testing equipment is regularly calibrated in accordance with our internal quality management system. This ensures measurement accuracy, repeatable results and the long-term reliability of all inspection processes.

fixtures.title: Test fixture development
fixtures.description: For specific projects, we design and manufacture our own test fixtures and automated test stations. This allows us to tailor testing to individual customer requirements and provide the highest level of inspection for every product.

contact.description: A comprehensive quality management system, modern inspection technologies and an experienced team of specialists enable Hokami to deliver electronic assemblies that meet the highest requirements for quality, safety and long-term operational reliability.

hero.title: Conformal coating
hero.description: Conformal coating effectively protects printed circuit boards and electronic components against adverse environmental influences. It significantly extends the service life of electronics, improves operational reliability and enables products to be used in demanding operating conditions.

first.title: Protection for demanding applications
first.p1: At Hokami, we provide professional PCB coating for applications exposed to increased humidity, condensation, dust, chemicals, salt spray, vibration or significant temperature changes. Coating is a standard part of electronics manufacturing for industrial, energy, medical, railway and other applications requiring high long-term reliability.
first.p2: We use proven Peters SL1331N-LF-D/17 and Peters SL1301 ECO-FLZ-23 protective coatings, or other materials to customer specifications. We inspect the applied protective layer under UV light for fast, precise assessment of coating uniformity and coverage.
first.imageAlt: An automated line applying protective coating to electronic assemblies.

second.title: Coating options
second.p1: We offer several methods of applying protective coating according to the product and customer requirements:
second.imageAlt: Close-up of a printed circuit board populated with electronic components.

items.selective: Selective coating of specific PCB areas

second.conclusion: Our wide range of technologies allows us to choose the optimal application method for each project, providing maximum protection for electronic assemblies while maintaining high manufacturing efficiency.

equipment.title: Manufacturing equipment
equipment.description: Coating is applied on modern Nordson ASYMTEK automated lines, ensuring precise, repeatable and fully controlled application of protective coatings.

lines.title: Automated coating lines
lines.item: {model} equipped with a closed heated circuit, automatic laser height measurement, application width correction and a camera-based process inspection system.
lines.description: The technology enables precise coating of electronic assemblies populated using both SMT and THT technologies.

drying.title: Drying
drying.item: In-line curing oven for controlled curing of protective coatings.

quality.title: Quality inspection
quality.description: Every coated electronic assembly undergoes UV inspection of the applied layer. We check coverage of the required areas, layer uniformity and any unwanted defects. Controlled application and curing ensure highly repeatable production and long-term protection of electronic products.

contact.description: Modern technologies, automated manufacturing processes and many years of experience enable us to offer reliable protection for electronic assemblies, significantly improving their durability, service life and operational reliability even in the most demanding applications.

hero.title: Mechanical assembly
hero.description: At Hokami, manufacturing goes beyond PCB assembly. Our aim is to deliver fully finished products ready for immediate use, installation or distribution. Our wide range of assembly and completion services ensures that final products are assembled precisely to technical documentation and individual customer requirements.

first.title: Completing the finished product
first.p1: Mechanical assembly is an important part of our comprehensive EMS services. We assemble electronic units into plastic and metal enclosures and install mechanical parts, cable harnesses, connectors, heatsinks, displays, controls and other components. Every product undergoes thorough assembly and functional inspection before final packaging and dispatch.
first.p2: Our manufacturing processes are designed to handle prototypes, small batches and high-volume orders efficiently. Flexible production organisation allows us to tailor the scope of completion to customer requirements, from simple mechanical assembly to delivery of a complete finished product including packaging, labelling and logistics services.
first.imageAlt: An operator completing an electronic product at an assembly workstation.

second.title: A complete solution under one roof
second.p1: By combining SMT and THT production, testing, coating, mechanical assembly and logistics services, we offer a complete manufacturing solution from a single location. This removes the need to coordinate multiple suppliers, shortens delivery times, simplifies project management and improves overall quality and manufacturing efficiency.
second.imageAlt: An operator performing the final assembly of an electronic unit.

included.title: Our services include
included.parts: Mechanical assembly of plastic and metal parts
included.enclosures: Installing electronic assemblies in plastic and metal enclosures
included.completion: Complete assembly of the finished product
included.components: Installing displays, connectors, heatsinks, fans, buttons and other mechanical components
included.labeling: Labelling products with customer labels, serial numbers, barcodes and QR codes
included.logistics: Logistics services and delivery to a specified location worldwide

contact.description: Our aim is to deliver a product that is fully ready for immediate use, installation or direct distribution to the end customer when manufacturing is complete.

hero.title: SMT stencils
hero.description: A high-quality SMT stencil is essential for precise solder paste application and high-quality SMT assembly. At Hokami, we arrange the manufacture of highly precise laser-cut steel stencils for prototype and series production of electronic assemblies.

first.title: Express delivery and precision
first.p1: Long-standing, proven partners and an efficient manufacturing process enable us to provide both stencil manufacturing and express delivery. For urgent projects, we can dispatch a stencil within 24 hours of receiving the order.
first.p2: Every stencil is manufactured with maximum aperture precision, high dimensional stability and a long service life. A correctly designed stencil contributes significantly to high-quality solder paste application, fewer manufacturing defects and a stable SMT process.
first.imageAlt: Equipment for the precise manufacture of laser-cut SMT stencils.

second.title: Precision that makes the difference
second.p1: High-quality SMT manufacturing starts with precise solder paste application. We therefore focus on correct stencil design, precise laser processing and high manufacturing accuracy. This delivers a stable printing process, highly repeatable production and fewer manufacturing defects from the very first operation.
second.imageAlt: Close-up of apertures in a steel solder paste stencil.
